versions.content: If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called, the SOME/ IP TP module shall derive the following SOME/IP header information from the first 12 bytes of the received PDU: • Request ID [32 bit] • Protocol Version [8 bit] • Interface Version [8 bit] • Message Type [8 bit] • Return Code [8 bit] • Offset [28 bit] • Reserved bits [3 bit] • More Segment Flag [1 bit]
